title: A week to plan: something picked for each day from a list, and what the week adds up to
about: Jobs for the week, shifts per day, a training week, a rota: rows of a plan table (a day and the thing picked for it) over a list of things to pick from. Each day of the week is named (Monday 16 Nov), shows what is picked with Change and Clear, or a Pick button listing the things; arrows move to other weeks. With PARTS (rows of what each thing needs: an item, a quantity, a unit) the week's totals are listed beside it, summed over the days (the materials to buy, the hours, the parts). Choose it over a table of dated rows whenever the request plans a week.

table.about: the plan table (a row per day and pick)

items.about: the table of the things to pick from

key.about: names the pattern's data and state

day.about: the plan column with the day ('YYYY-MM-DD')

item.about: the plan column holding the picked thing's id

name.about: the things column with each one's name

parts.about: a table of what each thing needs (for the week's totals)

of.about: the parts column holding the thing's id

part.about: the parts column naming what is needed

qty.about: the parts column with how much

unit.about: the parts column with its unit

totals.about: the heading over the week's totals

{{key}}_rows.sql: SELECT * FROM {{table}} WHERE days_between(:start, {{day}}) BETWEEN 0 AND 6 LIMIT 200

data.{{key}}_items: SELECT id, {{name}} AS sa_name FROM {{items}} ORDER BY {{name}} LIMIT 300

$value.sql: SELECT p.{{part}} AS part, p.{{unit}} AS unit, SUM(p.{{qty}}) AS qty FROM {{table}} w JOIN {{parts}} p ON p.{{of}} = w.{{item}} WHERE days_between(:start, w.{{day}}) BETWEEN 0 AND 6 GROUP BY p.{{part}}, p.{{unit}} ORDER BY part LIMIT 300

let.{{key}}_set: =(d, id) => { const r = {{key}}_on(d); return r ? app.update({{table|json}}, r.id, { {{item}}: id }) : app.insert({{table|json}}, { {{day}}: d, {{item}}: id }); }

then.text: Pick for a day and what it needs adds up here.
